reference_view_selection: greedy independent target visibility coverage from the original geometry; constructor image quality chooses each target's crop among selected views
image_sampling: one natural registered RGB crop per eligible NR3D target; best constructor quality among up to four visibility-covering views; smallest SHA256(scene/instance/joint-response) if more than 32
construction_revision: v1 fixed temporal quantiles yielded empty rooms; revised before any model fit or benchmark scoring. Training construction permits partial target coverage, with at least two retained target views; benchmark protocol unchanged
query_holdout: union of reference frames, temporal +/-5 frames and camera-near views (<0.10 m, <8 degrees) removed from every input to every candidate provider
image_teachers: original DINOv2 vitb14 local symmetric Chamfer with original SAM masks
pairing: all ordered complete-answer pairs; equal room, modality, query weight
calibration: one shared margin, maximize room-modality macro actual IoU gain with nonnegative gain in every calibration room-modality cell; reject all allowed
